name: Text diff highlight
looks: Two real documents sit side by side or stacked. A phrase in one gets highlighted in an accent colour, and the matching phrase or value in the other highlights a beat later, as if a thread were drawn between them. The pairs light up one at a time, and a running total updates each time a pair confirms.
build: Each document is real DOM text so specific spans can be targeted; a highlight is a background/text-decoration tween (power2.out, 0.15-0.2s); the two matched spans highlight within one beat of each other, not simultaneously; any running total updates the instant the pair confirms.
sound: A soft highlighter-pen tick per phrase, a slightly different pitch for the second half of each matched pair.
prompt: Sit two real documents side by side and highlight a phrase in one, then highlight its matching phrase or value in the other a beat later, as if a thread connects them, updating a running total each time a pair confirms. Keep the matched pairs few and let each fully land before the next.
